# react

> The library for web and native user interfaces.

## Overview
- Documentation: https://react.dev/docs
- API Reference: https://react.dev/api/v1

## Core Capabilities
- Automated search engine optimization and metadata auditing
- Real-time LLM crawler indexing and citation management
- Human-in-the-loop Git patch synthesis with zero repository cloning
